name: Marketplace Domain Dependency Graph & Cycle Analysis

dependencies.nature: Advertiser chooses screen categories and screens for campaign definition.
Campaign estimation queries pricing engines for budget recommendations.
Uploaded creatives bind directly to existing booking IDs.
dependencies.coupling: Foreign key (booking_id) and lifecycle state transitions

dependencies.nature: Media validation verifies dimensions against screen display specs.
Media assets link to dynamic templates and rendering assets.
Every screen belongs to a screen provider or partner.
Partners manage assigned fleet screens and locations.
Pricing rules inspect screen pricing base_rate, base_price_per_second, and categories.
Capacity checking verifies screen operating hours and slot capacities.
Capacity and conflict checking inspects existing confirmed/running bookings for time overlap.
Booking creates line items linking screens to campaigns.
dependencies.coupling: Foreign key (screen_id) and screen snapshot fields

dependencies.nature: Booking creation requests pricing calculations and discounts.
Booking creation verifies capacity and locks slots.
Partner bookings associate partner_id and apply commission logic.
dependencies.coupling: Direct model lookup and column population

dependencies.nature: Booking lifecycle transitions depend on payment confirmation events.
Payments are created for a specific booking_id and update booking status to confirmed/paid.
Payment completion triggers commission records for referring partners.
Settlement aggregates completed bookings to compute net payable payouts.
Settlement computes provider balances and payouts.
Settlement computes partner commission payouts.
Analytics aggregate bookings, slots, and revenue.
Financial reports aggregate cash receipts and payment records.
Occupancy reports aggregate screen utilization.

cycle_analysis.mechanism: CampaignPricingService constructor injects LoyaltyService; LoyaltyService internally calls app(CampaignPricingService::class) dynamically at runtime.
cycle_analysis.mitigation_plan: Decouple LoyaltyService from CampaignPricingService in Phase 0.5. Pass customer loyalty discount points into the pure calculation engine as a pre-resolved Value Object rather than allowing dynamic circular container resolution.

cycle_analysis.mechanism: Booking depends on Availability to check slot capacity before confirming. Availability queries historical and upcoming Bookings to calculate occupied seconds per loop.
cycle_analysis.mitigation_plan: Availability should not query Eloquent Booking domain entities directly for commercial logic. In the target architecture, Availability maintains an inventory/occupancy projection (TimeSlot/ScreenSchedule) or reads from a dedicated BookedSlotReadModel.

cycle_analysis.mechanism: PaymentService directly writes to `bookings.payment_status` and `bookings.status`. BookingController creates pending `payments` records during manual booking.
cycle_analysis.mitigation_plan: Payment domain should publish a `PaymentReceived` / `PaymentCompleted` domain event or application workflow step. The Booking application use case listens to the event or orchestrates the transition, removing direct foreign table updates across domains.

cycle_analysis.mechanism: SettlementService updates screen_providers.balance directly inside payout loops.
cycle_analysis.mitigation_plan: Provider domain encapsulates provider balance mutations via explicit `creditBalance()` and `debitBalance()` methods or ledger entries, rather than Settlement directly executing update queries on foreign models.
